safety.intro: If {call} does not answer a reminder, we send one gentle nudge first and tell you only when it matters. A reply at any point stops everything.

safety.speedLine: Medicines: nudge after {a} min, alert after {b} min. Daily check-in: nudge after {c} min, alert after {d} min.
safety.alertHint: One forgotten tap is usually not an emergency, so we record it without alerting you. Critical medicines always alert on the first miss. A silent daily check-in plus an unanswered reminder counts as 2.
safety.criticalHint: Medicines that must not be missed, such as insulin. An unanswered reminder for one of these alerts you right away.
safety.silentHint: After {days} days without any reply we stop the extra nudges and alerts and send you one summary. Reminders and check-ins continue.
safety.emergencyBody: Chhaon cannot call for help or send anyone to {call}. In an emergency, call your local emergency number (112 in India).

love.intro: When {call} confirms a medicine or answers the morning check-in, you can send a small warm message back on WhatsApp, like "Riya saw that you took your medicine ❤️". It only goes out after {call} has written to us, so it never costs extra.

love.rule1: A message is sent only after {call} has written to us in the last 24 hours. If not, it waits for their next reply, up to 2 days.
love.rule2: If several of you react within 2 minutes, {call} gets one message.
love.rule3: No more than 3 love messages a day, and none between 9 PM and 7 AM {call}'s time.
love.rule4: {call} can write NO HEARTS at any time to stop only these messages.
